name: Create Fitness Circuit Flipchart
description:
A middle school PE teacher needs a circuit training flipchart. Create a 4-page ActivInspire flipchart saved to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/circuit_training_stations.flipchart' with the following structure:

Page 1 — Title & Safety: Title 'Circuit Training: Bodyweight Basics' and safety text including 'Warm up before starting'.

Page 2 — Station 1: Exercise 'Jumping Jacks', a green circle shape (difficulty indicator), text '30 reps', and form cue 'Keep arms fully extended'.

Page 3 — Station 2: Exercise 'Wall Sit', a yellow or orange circle shape, text '45 seconds', and form cue 'Back flat against the wall'.

Page 4 — Station 3: Exercise 'Push-Ups', a red circle shape, text '15 reps', and form cue 'Keep your core tight'.

Note: Use the Shape tool to draw the circles. Ensure you have exactly 4 pages.
